import subprocess,sys,json,math
cases=[
 (b'', 'empty'),
 (b'   \n\t', 'whitespace'),
 (b'{', 'malformed'),
 (b'{"streams":[],"streams":[]}', 'top duplicate'),
 (b'{"streams":[{"x":{"a":1,"a":2}}]}', 'nested duplicate'),
 (b'{"x":NaN}', 'NaN'),
 (b'{"x":Infinity}', 'Infinity'),
 (b'{"x":-Infinity}', '-Infinity'),
 (b'{"x":1e9999}', 'float overflow'),
 (b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"streams":[]}', 'BOM'),
 (b' \xef\xbb\xbf{"streams":[]}', 'BOM after ws'),
 (b'{"x":"\xff"}', 'bad utf8'),
 (b'{"streams":[]} trailing', 'trailing'),
]
for data,name in cases:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-u','submission/main.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert p.returncode==0,(name,p.returncode)
 out=json.loads(p.stdout)
 assert out=={'error':'invalid_json'},(name,out)
print('malformed suite okay')
# valid empty request and valid whitespace
for data in [b'{"streams":[]}',b' \n {"streams":[]} \t\n']:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-u','submission/main.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert p.returncode==0 and json.loads(p.stdout)=={'streams':[]}
print('valid empty okay')
PY
